page_title: Food Photo Editor for Restaurants | DishVivid

sources.entry: DishVivid - Restaurant-photo editing with free local manual controls and optional sign-in/allowance-based AI, with food details requiring human review (AI-assisted listing submitted on behalf of the project). #photo-editing

summary.name: DishVivid
summary.one_liner: A web-based food photo editor for restaurants that adjusts light, color and crop for menu and delivery listing photos, with optional AI generation.
use_cases: Brightening and color-correcting photos of dishes for a restaurant menu
Preparing food images for delivery app listings
Cropping dish photos for café or social media posts
Comparing an edited food photo against the original before publishing
Generating an optional AI edit candidate of a dish photo
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a food photo editor aimed at restaurants, cafés and delivery listings. Users can upload a photo and adjust lighting, color and crop manually, then compare edits with the original and export as JPEG (other formats are mentioned as "the format you need"). Manual editing and JPEG download require no account, and the page says manual edits stay on the device. An optional AI generation step requires sign-in and available edits, with each completed candidate using one edit. The page emphasizes reviewing ingredients, portion size, plate shape and packaging before approving any edited image, and includes a demo of a stock burger photo with brightness, contrast and color adjustments.
notable: Manual light, color and crop editing works without an account and keeps edits on the device
Side-by-side comparison with the original and review step to avoid misleading food images
Optional AI candidate generation using an allowance of edits after sign-in
caveats: AI generation requires sign-in and available edits; account balance and pricing must be checked before generating
Gallery styles are illustrative, not customer results
Current allowances and pricing are not stated on the page; they are linked from a separate pricing page
